sources.title: Multi-Agent Legacy Architecture
sources.summary_ru: Статья представляет фреймворк MALA — мультиагентную архитектуру для интеграции ИИ в устаревшие промышленные системы без замены существующего ПО.
sources.snippet: MALA Framework: A Framework for Multi-Agent AI Integration in Legacy Industrial Systems This work introduces MALA (Multi Agent Legacy Architecture) , a supervised multi-agent framework designed for industrial environments operating on heterogeneous legacy systems that lack modern APIs. Research Overview Many industrial environments continue to rely on terminal-based enterprise systems, flat-file archives, scanned documents, and local operational logs accumulated over decades. These systems often expose limited interoperability and present barriers to contemporary AI integration.

sources.title: Convergence of Reinforcement Learning and Time-Sensitive Networking for Future Industrial AI Agent Communication: Fundamentals, Challenges, and Opportunities
sources.summary_ru: Исследуется интеграция обучения с подкреплением и сетей временной чувствительности для обеспечения надежной и быстрой коммуникации промышленных ИИ-агентов.
sources.snippet: In contrast to IT counterparts, future industrial AI agents operate under unique constraints that demand both adaptive intelligence and strictly deterministic communication with ultra-low latency and ultra-high reliability. To address these stringent requirements, the convergence of reinforcement learning (RL) and Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) has emerged as a critical enabler.

sources.title: QID-NPI: Edge-Native Cognitive Hypervisors for Deterministic Context Injection in Zero-Trust SCADA Environments
sources.summary_ru: Рассматривается когнитивный гипервизор QID-NPI, обеспечивающий безопасную обработку данных на границе сети промышленного предприятия с применением квантованных моделей ИИ.
sources.snippet: QID-NPI addresses both barriers through a deterministic context preprocessing layer and a multi-agent inference architecture deploying specialized quantized foundation models (including Llama-3. 3-70B and DeepSeek-R1-32B) at 4-bit precision on edge hardware. Operating entirely within the plant network boundary, the system generates differentiated outputs per production batch with no data egress. A secondary air-gapped delivery mechanism encodes sanitized prompts into QR codes for local inference on mobile devices, addressing last-mile operator access.

sources.title: Opportunities and Challenges of Foundation Models in Industrial Manufacturing
sources.summary_ru: Анализируются возможности и сложности внедрения фундаментальных моделей ИИ в промышленное производство, подчеркивается необходимость учета технических, этических и отраслевых аспектов.
sources.snippet: The field of artificial intelligence (AI) is undergoing a transformative shift, propelled by the emergence of Foundation Models such as BERT, DALL-E, and GPT. These models, trained on large and diverse datasets using self-supervision techniques at unprecedented scales, demonstrate remarkable adaptability across numerous downstream tasks. Their versatility underscores their pivotal role in the evolving AI landscape. In this paper, we explore the complexities of Foundation Models, delving into their broad capabilities that span from natural language processing to advanced robotic manipulation.

sources.title: AutoChemSchematic AI: Agentic Physics-Aware Automation for Chemical Manufacturing Scale-Up
sources.summary_ru: Представлена система AutoChemSchematic AI для автоматизации проектирования технологических схем химических производств с учетом физических законов и моделирования процессов.
sources.snippet: Recent advances in generative AI have accelerated the discovery of novel chemicals and materials. However, scaling these discoveries to industrial production remains a major bottleneck due to the synthesis gap -- the need to develop entirely new manufacturing processes. This challenge requires detailed engineering blueprints: PFDs for equipment layouts and material/energy flows, and PIDs for process plant operations. Current AI systems cannot yet reliably generate these critical engineering schematics, creating a fundamental obstacle to manufacturing scale-up of novel discoveries.

sources.snippet: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is making a profound impact in almost every domain. A vital enabler of its great success is the availability of abundant and high-quality data for building machine learning models. Recently, the role of data in AI has been significantly magnified, giving rise to the emerging concept of data-centric AI. The attention of researchers and practitioners has gradually shifted from advancing model design to enhancing the quality and quantity of the data.

sources.title: AI Alignment: A Comprehensive Survey
sources.summary_ru: Рассматривается проблема согласования целей ИИ с ценностями человека (выравнивание ИИ), выделяются четыре ключевых принципа: надежность, интерпретируемость, управляемость и этичность.
sources.snippet: AI alignment aims to make AI systems behave in line with human intentions and values. As AI systems grow more capable, so do risks from misalignment. To provide a comprehensive and up-to-date overview of the alignment field, in this survey, we delve into the core concepts, methodology, and practice of alignment. First, we identify four principles as the key objectives of AI alignment: Robustness, Interpretability, Controllability, and Ethicality (RICE).

sources.snippet: Intelligent robotics has the potential to revolutionize various industries by amplifying output, streamlining operations, and enriching customer interactions. This systematic literature review aims to analyze emerging technologies and trends in intelligent robotics, addressing key research questions, identifying challenges and opportunities, and proposing the best practices for responsible and beneficial integration into various sectors.

sources.title: Brain-inspired Intelligent Robotics: Theoretical Analysis and Systematic Application
sources.summary_ru: Теоретический анализ и практическая реализация мозгоподобных интеллектуальных роботизированных систем с визуальной когнитивностью, принятием решений и мускульно-скелетными структурами (2023 год).
sources.snippet: With the development of the manufacturing and service industries, the requirement for the comprehensive performance of robotics is growing. Numerous types of bio-inspired robotics have been investigated to realize human-like motion control and manipulation. A study route from inner mechanisms to external structures is proposed to imitate humans and animals better. With this idea, a brain-inspired intelligent robotic system is constructed that contains visual cognition, decision-making, motion control, and musculoskeletal structures.

sources.snippet: Soft robotics is an exciting field of science and technology that enables robots to manipulate objects with human-like dexterity. Soft robots can handle delicate objects with care, access remote areas, and offer realistic feedback on their handling performance. However, increased dexterity and mechanical compliance of soft robots come with the need for accurate control of the position and shape of these robots. Therefore, soft robots must be equipped with sensors for better perception of their surroundings, location, force, temperature, shape, and other stimuli for effective usage.

sources.summary_ru: Рассмотрение этических вопросов, связанных с использованием ИИ и робототехники в здравоохранении, включая конфиденциальность, предвзятость алгоритмов и ответственность разработчиков (2023 год).
sources.snippet: Integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) and robotics in healthcare heralds a new era of medical innovation, promising enhanced diagnostics, streamlined processes, and improved patient care. However, this technological revolution is accompanied by intricate ethical implications that demand meticulous consideration. This article navigates the complex ethical terrain surrounding AI and robotics in healthcare, delving into specific dimensions and providing strategies and best practices for ethical navigation.

sources.title: A Review of the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare

sources.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) applications have transformed healthcare. This study is based on a general literature review uncovering the role of AI in healthcare and focuses on the following key aspects: (i) medical imaging and diagnostics, (ii) virtual patient care, (iii) medical research and drug discovery, (iv) patient engagement and compliance, (v) rehabilitation, and (vi) other administrative applications.

sources.title: Clinical applications of artificial intelligence in robotic surgery
sources.summary_ru: Изучение вклада ИИ в роботизированную хирургию, включая автоматизацию операций, оценку хирургических навыков и обеспечение обратной связи для обучения врачей (2024 год).
sources.snippet: Artificial intelligence (AI) is revolutionizing nearly every aspect of modern life. In the medical field, robotic surgery is the sector with some of the most innovative and impactful advancements. In this narrative review, we outline recent contributions of AI to the field of robotic surgery with a particular focus on intraoperative enhancement. sources.snippet: Modern hyper-scale AI models and spatial edge applications face severe power dissipation bottlenecks and the von Neumann memory wall. cards.advantage_ru: Повышение эффективности использования энергии и снижение воздействия на окружающую среду за счет инновационных архитектур и накопителей энергии, способных сглаживать пиковую нагрузку на электросети.
cards.case_example_ru: Анализируется применение литиевых батарей (оксид титаната лития и фосфат железа лития) совместно с другими технологиями накопления энергии для обеспечения стабильной работы дата-центров ИИ при резких скачках нагрузки.
cards.explanation_ru: Технологии находятся на этапе активного научного изучения и разработки, появляются публикации, посвященные внедрению новых энергосберегающих решений и систем накопления энергии для дата-центров ИИ. Исследования и разработка, описаны требования и характеристики перспективных систем накопления энергии для дата-центров. Растущий интерес к устойчивой инфраструктуре ИИ подтверждается увеличением количества публикаций и обсуждением интеграции нейроморфных систем и гибридных накопителей энергии в дата-центры.

sources.title: Neuromorphic hardware for sustainable AI data centers
sources.summary_ru: Статья посвящена анализу причин отсутствия нейроморфных систем в коммерческих дата-центрах ИИ и предлагает рекомендации по их внедрению для создания энергоэффективной и устойчивой инфраструктуры.
sources.snippet: As humans advance toward a higher level of artificial intelligence, it is always at the cost of escalating computational resource consumption, which requires developing novel solutions to meet the exponential growth of AI computing demand. Neuromorphic hardware takes inspiration from how the brain processes information and promises energy-efficient computing of AI workloads. Despite its potential, neuromorphic hardware has not found its way into commercial AI data centers.

sources.title: Scalable, Distributed AI Frameworks: Leveraging Cloud Computing for Enhanced Deep Learning Performance and Efficiency
sources.summary_ru: Обзор масштабируемых распределённых фреймворков ИИ, использующих облачные вычисления для повышения производительности глубокого обучения и эффективности работы моделей.
sources.snippet: In recent years, the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and cloud computing has emerged as a promising avenue for addressing the growing computational demands of AI applications. This paper presents a comprehensive study of scalable, distributed AI frameworks leveraging cloud computing for enhanced deep learning performance and efficiency. We first provide an overview of popular AI frameworks and cloud services, highlighting their respective strengths and weaknesses.

sources.title: Integration of IoT-Enabled Technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Smart City Scenario: Recent Advancements and Future Trends
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает интеграцию технологий Интернета вещей и искусственного интеллекта для управления умными городами, подчеркивая роль 5G и AI в развитии городской инфраструктуры.
sources.snippet: By leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI) to analyze the vast amount of IoT data available, new opportunities are emerging to design and manage futuristic smart cities. In this review article, we provide an overview of smart cities, defining their characteristics and exploring the architecture of IoT. A detailed analysis of various wireless communication technologies employed in smart city applications is presented, with extensive research conducted to determine the most appropriate communication technologies for specific use cases.

sources.title: Data-centric Artificial Intelligence: A Survey
sources.summary_ru: Обзор концепции data-centric AI, направленной на улучшение качества и объема данных для построения эффективных моделей машинного обучения.
sources.snippet: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is making a profound impact in almost every domain. A vital enabler of its great success is the availability of abundant and high-quality data for building machine learning models. Recently, the role of data in AI has been significantly magnified, giving rise to the emerging concept of data-centric AI. The attention of researchers and practitioners has gradually shifted from advancing model design to enhancing the quality and quantity of the data.

sources.title: Energy Storage Systems for AI Data Centers: A Review of Technologies, Characteristics, and Applicability
sources.summary_ru: Обзор технологий систем накопления энергии, применимых для дата-центров ИИ, с акцентом на требования быстрой реакции, долговечности и способности выдерживать частые циклы зарядки-разрядки.
sources.snippet: The fastest growth in electricity demand in the industrialized world will likely come from the broad adoption of artificial intelligence (AI)—accelerated by the rise of generative AI models such as OpenAI’s ChatGPT. The global “data center arms race” is driving up power demand and grid stress, which creates local and regional challenges because people in the area understand that the additional data center-related electricity demand is coming from faraway places, and they will have to support the additional infrastructure while not directly benefiting from it.

cards.description_ru: Технология основана на использовании генеративных состязательных сетей (GAN) для создания синтетических финансовых транзакций, позволяющих обучать модели машинного обучения выявлению мошеннических операций без риска нарушения конфиденциальности реальных данных.
cards.advantage_ru: Позволяет эффективно тренировать модели обнаружения мошенничества на больших объемах синтетических данных, сохраняя конфиденциальность и соответствие регуляторным требованиям.
cards.case_example_ru: Исследователи из arXiv провели сравнительный анализ пяти алгоритмов генерации синтетических финансовых транзакций с помощью GAN, включая CTGAN, DoppelGANger, Wasserstein GAN, Financial Diffusion и Tabular Variational AutoEncoders, оценив их по таким параметрам, как достоверность, качество синтеза, эффективность, приватность и структура графа.
cards.explanation_ru: Технология находится на ранней стадии внедрения: проводятся научные публикации и эксперименты по сравнению различных архитектур GAN для генерации синтетических данных и повышения эффективности обнаружения мошенничества. Растущий интерес подтверждается публикациями в научных журналах в течение последних двух лет. Технология находится на стадии исследований и прототипирования, активно обсуждается в академическом сообществе. Интерес к применению GAN для генерации синтетических финансовых данных растет: публикации появляются регулярно начиная с 2023 года, акцент делается на приватности и качестве синтезируемых данных.

sources.title: Generative AI for Banks: Benchmarks and Algorithms for Synthetic Financial Transaction Data
sources.summary_ru: Статья рассматривает использование генеративных состязательных сетей (GAN) для создания синтетических финансовых транзакций, сравнивает пять ведущих алгоритмов по критериям качества, приватности и структуры данных.
sources.snippet: The banking sector faces challenges in using deep learning due to data sensitivity and regulatory constraints, but generative AI may offer a solution. Thus, this study identifies effective algorithms for generating synthetic financial transaction data and evaluates five leading models - Conditional Tabular Generative Adversarial Networks (CTGAN), DoppelGANger (DGAN), Wasserstein GAN, Financial Diffusion (FinDiff), and Tabular Variational AutoEncoders (TVAE) - across five criteria: fidelity, synthesis quality, efficiency, privacy, and graph structure.

sources.title: Utilizing GANs for Fraud Detection: Model Training with Synthetic Transaction Data
sources.summary_ru: Исследование посвящено использованию GAN для обнаружения мошенничества, описаны принципы работы GAN и их преимущества в сравнении с традиционными методами аномалии для повышения безопасности транзакций.
sources.snippet: Anomaly detection is a critical challenge across various research domains, aiming to identify instances that deviate from normal data distributions. This paper explores the application of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) in fraud detection, comparing their advantages with traditional methods. GANs, a type of Artificial Neural Network (ANN), have shown promise in modeling complex data distributions, making them effective tools for anomaly detection.

sources.title: Machine Learning for Synthetic Data Generation: A Review
sources.summary_ru: Обзор посвящен методам генерации синтетических данных с помощью машинного обучения, рассматриваются приложения в финансах и других областях, подчеркиваются проблемы приватности и справедливости.
sources.snippet: Machine learning heavily relies on data, but real-world applications often encounter various data-related issues. These include data of poor quality, insufficient data points leading to under-fitting of machine learning models, and difficulties in data access due to concerns surrounding privacy, safety, and regulations. In light of these challenges, the concept of synthetic data generation emerges as a promising alternative that allows for data sharing and utilization in ways that real-world data cannot facilitate.

cards.description_ru: Технология предполагает использование глубоких нейронных сетей и методов машинного обучения для построения оптимальных криптовалютных портфелей и автоматизации торговых решений на примере Ethereum.
cards.advantage_ru: Алгоритмы позволяют автоматически формировать портфель с минимизацией рисков и максимизацией доходности, используя исторические данные и современные методы глубокого обучения.
cards.case_example_ru: Авторы научной статьи предложили алгоритм на основе нейронных сетей, который формирует портфель из отрицательно коррелированных активов и обучается распределять веса между ними для максимизации коэффициента Шарпа. Активизация публикаций наблюдается с 2023 года. Технология находится на стадии научных исследований и экспериментов, пока не вышла на уровень коммерческого внедрения. Наблюдается растущий научный интерес к применению машинного обучения и нейронных сетей в торговле криптовалютами, особенно Ethereum, с публикацией новых подходов каждые несколько месяцев.

sources.title: Cryptocurrency Portfolio Optimization by Neural Networks
sources.summary_ru: Предложен алгоритм на основе нейронных сетей для формирования оптимального криптовалютного портфеля с использованием производных инструментов и максимизацией коэффициента Шарпа.
sources.snippet: Many cryptocurrency brokers nowadays offer a variety of derivative assets that allow traders to perform hedging or speculation. This paper proposes an effective algorithm based on neural networks to take advantage of these investment products. The proposed algorithm constructs a portfolio that contains a pair of negatively correlated assets. A deep neural network, which outputs the allocation weight of each asset at a time interval, is trained to maximize the Sharpe ratio.

sources.title: A Framework for Empowering Reinforcement Learning Agents with Causal Analysis: Enhancing Automated Cryptocurrency Trading
sources.summary_ru: Представлен фреймворк CausalReinforceNet, использующий байесовский подход и динамические байесовские сети вместе с методами обучения с подкреплением для улучшения автоматизированной торговли криптовалютами.
sources.snippet: Despite advances in artificial intelligence-enhanced trading methods, developing a profitable automated trading system remains challenging in the rapidly evolving cryptocurrency market. This research focuses on developing a reinforcement learning (RL) framework to tackle the complexities of trading five prominent altcoins: Binance Coin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Ripple, and Tether. To this end, we present the CausalReinforceNet~(CRN) framework, which integrates both Bayesian and dynamic Bayesian network techniques to empower the RL agent in trade decision-making.

sources.title: Machine learning Ethereum cryptocurrency prediction and knowledge-based investment strategies
sources.summary_ru: Разработан новый подход прогнозирования цены Ethereum с применением рекуррентных нейронных сетей GRU и LSTM, а также метода SVM для классификации тенденций рынка криптовалюты.
sources.snippet: This work proposes a novel methodology to help in decision making in the cryptocurrency market. Two investment strategies have been designed for Ethereum (ETH), based on predictions of the price and trend of this cryptocurrency using real data. The two Ethereum cryptocurrency prediction systems rely solely on past values of other contextual stock indices, market indicators and online trends, and ignore any technical indicators of price evolution. Real data from cryptocurrency market has been collected and processed with different feature selection methods.

sources.title: TRiSM for Agentic AI: A Review of Trust, Risk, and Security Management in LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems
sources.summary_ru: (Семантикс Школар) Обзор подходов к управлению доверием, рисками и безопасностью в мультиагентных системах на основе LLM, предложена новая таксономия рисков и метрики качества взаимодействия агентов.
sources.snippet: Agentic AI systems, built upon large language models (LLMs) and deployed in multi-agent configurations, are redefining intelligence, autonomy, collaboration, and decision-making across enterprise and societal domains. This review presents a structured analysis of Trust, Risk, and Security Management (TRiSM) in the context of LLM-based Agentic Multi-Agent Systems (AMAS). We begin by examining the conceptual foundations of Agentic AI and highlight its architectural distinctions from traditional AI agents.

sources.title: Specification and Evaluation of Multi-Agent LLM Systems -- Prototype and Cybersecurity Applications
sources.summary_ru: (Арксив) Описан прототип мультиагентной системы на основе LLM, проверено применение в задачах кибербезопасности, продемонстрирована работоспособность подхода.
sources.snippet: Recent advancements in LLMs indicate potential for novel applications, as evidenced by the reasoning capabilities in the latest OpenAI and DeepSeek models. To apply these models to domain-specific applications beyond text generation, LLM-based multi-agent systems can be utilized to solve complex tasks, particularly by combining reasoning techniques, code generation, and software execution across multiple, potentially specialized LLMs.

sources.title: AgentRiskBOM: A Risk-Scoping Security Bill of Materials for Agentic AI Systems
sources.summary_ru: (Арксив) Предложен дополнительный слой к существующим схемам учёта компонентов ИИ — AgentRiskBOM, учитывающий права доступа, память, полномочия инструментов и коммуникации агентов.
sources.snippet: Agentic AI systems retrieve private context, invoke tools, write files, call external services, coordinate with other agents, and may act without human approval. Existing bill of materials artifacts improve transparency for dependencies, model metadata, and training provenance, but leave an agentic transparency gap: capability opacity, the absence of a structured account of what a deployed agent can access, remember, change, delegate, and prove afterward. This paper introduces AgentRiskBOM, a security BOM for risk-scoping tool-using AI agents.

sources.title: The Ethics of Autonomous AI Agents for Offensive Security
sources.summary_ru: (Арксив) Анализ этических проблем автономного ИИ, применяемого в наступательных операциях кибербезопасности, выделены особенности неопределённости поведения и сложности атрибуции ответственности.
sources.snippet: LLM-driven autonomous agents are reshaping offensive security. Unlike traditional penetration-testing tooling - deterministic, narrowly scoped, and operated by trained practitioners - agentic security tools exhibit indeterminacy along three independent dimensions. First, their actions are drawn from a non-deterministic policy whose outputs resist both ex-ante and ex-post explanation. This complicates incident attribution and pre-deployment safety reviews. Second, their impact is open-ended due to their non-deterministic actions, agency of utilized models, and opaque LLM supply-chains.

sources.title: Autonomous Web Hacking: Investigating the Capability Gap in Open-Source Large Language Model Agents

sources.snippet: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of autonomously interacting with websites and APIs to complete data-extraction and other web-based tasks. This raises an important security question: when an autonomous agent encounters obstacles during legitimate data extraction, will it attempt to discover or exploit vulnerabilities in the target system? This study investigates that question for open-weight LLM agents in the 7–8B parameter class.

sources.title: One Witness Layer Short: Runtime Witness, Witness Authority, Witness Theater, and the Governance-to-Action Closure Gap in AI Systems
sources.summary_ru: (Зендо) Статья подчёркивает необходимость независимой проверки действий ИИ-агентов в режиме реального времени и вводит концепцию 'независимого свидетеля' для подтверждения корректности работы систем.
sources.snippet: The paper introduces three concepts: Runtime Witness: independently inspectable evidence that a claimed mechanism operated during execution and causally constrained behavior. Witness Authority: an actor with standing to require, inspect, contest, and act upon that evidence. Witness Theater: the failure mode in which traces, logs, provenance records, or audit artifacts exist but function primarily as compliance signals rather than instruments of causal reconstruction.

sources.summary_ru: (Арксив) Представлена концепция и архитектура AIAuditTrack — блокчейн-фреймворк для аудита и управления рисками в мультиагентных средах, обеспечивающий идентификацию и отслеживание взаимодействий агентов.
sources.snippet: This paper presents AiAuditTrack (AAT), a blockchain-based framework for AI usage traffic recording and governance. AAT leverages decentralized identity (DID) and verifiable credentials (VC) to establish trusted and identifiable AI entities, and records inter-entity interaction trajectories on-chain to enable cross-system supervision and auditing. AI entities are modeled as nodes in a dynamic interaction graph, where edges represent time-specific behavioral trajectories.

sources.title: From Execution Evidence to Governed Reliance: A Grammar for Relying on What AI Agents Do
sources.summary_ru: (Зендо) Рассматривается переход от контроля моделей ИИ к контролю действий агентов, вводится многоуровневая система доказательств и доверия к действиям агента.
sources.snippet: Agentic AI is shifting AI governance from model oversight toward action oversight. The central governance problem is no longer only whether a model produced an inaccurate, biased, or unsafe output. It is whether an AI-mediated system was authorized to take a consequential protected action, whether evidence of that action can be independently verified, and whether a party with standing can rely on that evidence for a defined purpose.

sources.title: Albireo: Adaptive, Energy-Efficient Inference Framework for Video Object Detection on the Edge
sources.summary_ru: Статья описывает инфраструктурную платформу Albireo для эффективного обнаружения объектов в видео на устройствах края, снижающую энергопотребление на 12,1–17,6% при сохранении высокой точности.
sources.snippet: Video object detection on edge devices runs computationally expensive detectors over long frame streams, causing high energy consumption and sustained GPU utilization. Although consecutive frames are highly redundant, naive frame skipping is content-blind: it skips during critical moments such as object entry, occlusion recovery, and abrupt motion, degrading detection quality.

sources.title: Jetson-ORB-SLAM3: Accuracy-Preserving GPU Implementation for Edge Computing Devices
sources.summary_ru: Представлена реализация ORB-SLAM3 на GPU платформы NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, сохраняющая точность алгоритма за счет точного воспроизведения оригинального CPU-решения.
sources.snippet: We present an accuracy-preserving GPU implementation of ORB-SLAM3 for the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, whose GPU ORB front end reproduces the reference CPU detector algorithmically to 94. 7% exact keypoint agreement and 99. 9% descriptor bit agreement. This work also makes CNN-based loop closure edge-viable through native TensorRT. The visual front end (feature extraction) is offloaded to the GPU while the mapping and optimization back end is kept on the CPU, matching each computation to the hardware it suits.

sources.title: HELIX: A Closed-Loop Architecture for Personalised Driver Monitoring on Commodity Hardware
sources.summary_ru: Документ представляет систему HELIX — доказательство концепции архитектуры для персонального мониторинга состояния водителя на недорогих ПК без дискретных видеокарт.
sources.snippet: HELIX is a proof-of-concept closed-loop architecture for personalised driver monitoring using a low-cost frontal RGB webcam on commodity CPU hardware (no discrete GPU or hardware accelerator). It integrates CLAHE preprocessing, MediaPipe facial landmark extraction, EAR/MAR/head-tilt feature computation, automatic per-driver threshold calibration (SLCP/OPTC) with fixed-threshold fallback, EMA and Kalman smoothing, temporal hysteresis, a five-stage alerting controller, local SQLite logging, and optional Telegram-based escalation.

sources.snippet: The traditional approach to distributed deep neural network (DNN) inference in edge computing systems is data-distributed inference.
